name: Dialog
summary: A panel that asks the reader something, written as a <dialog>. It is shown the way a dialog is shown without JavaScript — open in the markup — and it is closed the way the browser closes one: the close button submits the form around it, and the form's method is dialog.
summaryZh: 一块用来跟读者说话的浮层,写成 <dialog>。它不用 JavaScript 就以对话框该有的样子出现 —— 标记里直接是 open —— 也用浏览器关对话框的办法来关:关闭按钮提交包着它的那个表单,而那个表单的 method 是 dialog。

variants.name: Centred
variants.note: The title and the actions are centred instead of being pushed to the two ends of the panel. It is the modifier um-dialog--center.

sizes.name: Small
sizes.note: A narrow panel. The width is a measure of the panel's own type, so it grows with the mood's text.

sizes.name: Medium
sizes.note: The default panel. The base class is already this width, so it needs no modifier.

sizes.name: Large
sizes.note: A wide panel, for a body of text rather than a line of it.

states.name: Open
states.note: The browser hides a dialog that has no open attribute, so the static form of this component is the open one.

states.name: Modal
states.note: The browser's own modal state. A dialog opened with showModal() is in the top layer and carries the backdrop the browser paints for it — the library paints no mask of its own.

states.name: Aligned to the centre
states.note: The panel sits in the middle of the screen instead of in the flow of the page.

states.name: Fullscreen
states.note: The panel takes the whole screen.

parts.name: Form
parts.note: The form around the content. Its method is dialog, which is what makes the close button work without a line of JavaScript.

parts.name: Header
parts.note: The top strip. It holds the title and the close button.

parts.name: Title
parts.note: The heading of the panel. The dialog points at it with aria-labelledby, so the reader hears what the panel is about.

parts.name: Footer
parts.note: The row at the bottom of the panel, where the actions live.

parts.name: Action
parts.note: The one action the panel is asking for. It is the filled button; the other buttons in the footer keep the neutral shape.

parts.name: Close
parts.note: The cross in the corner. It is a submit button inside the form, so submitting is the browser's own way of closing a dialog.

props.name: align
props.description: Where the title and the actions sit. The start alignment is the base class on its own; the centred one adds um-dialog--center.
props.descriptionZh: 标题和操作放在哪儿。start 就是只写基类;居中再加上 um-dialog--center。

props.name: size
props.description: How wide the panel is. The width is a measure of the panel's own type, so the panel grows with the mood's text instead of holding a fixed pixel width.
props.descriptionZh: 浮层有多宽。这几档用的是浮层自己的字号单位,所以浮层会跟着 mood 的文字一起变大,而不是卡在一个固定的像素宽度上。

props.name: center
props.description: Whether the title and the actions are centred. This is Element Plus's name for the `align` prop's centred value; either one of them centres the panel.
props.descriptionZh: 标题和操作是否居中。这是 Element Plus 对 `align` 取居中值时的叫法,两个都能让浮层居中。

props.name: align-center
props.description: Whether the panel sits in the middle of the screen rather than in the flow of the page. It adds um-dialog--align-center.
props.descriptionZh: 浮层是放在屏幕正中还是留在页面流里。它加上 um-dialog--align-center。

props.name: fullscreen
props.description: Whether the panel takes the whole screen. It adds um-dialog--fullscreen.
props.descriptionZh: 浮层是否占满整个屏幕。它加上 um-dialog--fullscreen。

props.name: modal
props.description: Whether the panel is opened as the browser's own modal dialog, in the top layer and with the backdrop the browser paints for it. The library paints no mask of its own.
props.descriptionZh: 浮层是否以浏览器自己的模态对话框打开:进入顶层,并带上浏览器为它画的遮罩。库自己不画遮罩。

props.name: model-value
props.description: Whether the panel is open. The binding wins over the static form, which is the open one.
props.descriptionZh: 浮层是否打开。绑定优先于静态形态 —— 静态形态就是打开的那一个。

props.name: show-close
props.description: Whether the panel carries a close button in its header.
props.descriptionZh: 浮层的头部是否带关闭按钮。

slots.name: header
slots.description: What is in the header, in place of the title. The close button stays: replacing the header removes the title, not the way out.
slots.descriptionZh: 头部里的内容,用来代替标题。关闭按钮会留下:换掉头部去掉的是标题,不是出口。

slots.name: footer
slots.description: The actions in the footer. This is Element Plus's name for the `actions` slot; either one of them fills the footer.
slots.descriptionZh: 底部里的操作。这是 Element Plus 对 `actions` 插槽的叫法,两个都能填满底部。

events.name: close
events.description: Fires when the panel closes. The close is the browser's own: the close button submits the form around the panel, and the browser tells the wrapper the dialog is done.
events.descriptionZh: 浮层关闭时触发。关闭是浏览器自己的动作:关闭按钮提交包着浮层的那个表单,浏览器告诉包装器对话框结束了。

events.name: open
events.description: Fires when the panel opens. The panel is open in the markup, so the event fires when it reaches the page and again whenever the host opens it after that.
events.descriptionZh: 浮层打开时触发。浮层在标记里就是打开的,所以事件在它进入页面时触发,之后宿主每次再打开它也会触发。

a11y.notes: The panel is a <dialog>, so the browser knows it is a dialog, and the dialog points at its title with aria-labelledby so the reader hears what the panel is about instead of a bare "dialog". The close button is a real button inside a form whose method is dialog: submitting it is the browser's own way of closing a dialog, so the library installs no listener and handles no key. A static dialog is not modal — it does not take the focus, it does not make the page behind it inert, and Escape does not close it, because all three of those belong to showModal(), and that is JavaScript. Put the panel in the flow where the reader expects it, and give the host a way to open it.
a11y.notesZh: 这块浮层是 <dialog>,所以浏览器知道它是个对话框;浮层用 aria-labelledby 指向标题,读屏听到的就是「这块面板是关于什么的」,而不是干巴巴一句「对话框」。关闭按钮是一个真正的按钮,在一个 method 为 dialog 的表单里:提交它就是浏览器自己关对话框的办法,所以库不用装监听器,也不用处理按键。静态的对话框不是模态的 —— 它不接管焦点,不让后面的页面失效,Escape 也关不掉它,因为这三件事都属于 showModal(),而那是 JavaScript。把浮层放在读者以为它在的位置,再由宿主给它一个打开的办法。

examples.title: Basic
examples.description: A panel with a title, a body and two actions. The close button is a submit button inside a form whose method is dialog, so it closes the panel the way the browser closes one — and the cross is drawn from two borders, so it needs no icon font.
examples.descriptionZh: 一块有标题、正文和两个操作的浮层。关闭按钮是 method 为 dialog 的表单里的提交按钮,所以它是用浏览器关对话框的办法把浮层关掉的 —— 那个叉是用两条边框画出来的,所以不用图标字体。

notes: The close button is the browser's own, not a handler of the library's. A <form method="dialog"> inside the dialog turns a submit into a close, so the button needs no listener and the component needs no JavaScript at all — which also means the button keeps working when the host opens the panel with showModal(). What the library does not paint is the mask: the backdrop of a modal dialog belongs to the browser, and the static form has none, because there is no role in the contract for a scrim and a second translucent layer over the page is a colour no role names.
notesZh: 关闭按钮是浏览器自己的,不是库写的处理器。浮层里的 <form method="dialog"> 把一次提交变成一次关闭,所以按钮不需要监听器,组件也一行 JavaScript 都没有 —— 这也意味着宿主用 showModal() 打开浮层时,按钮照样管用。库不画的是那层遮罩:模态对话框的背景属于浏览器,静态形态没有遮罩 —— 契约里没有给遮罩留角色,而盖在页面上的第二层半透明表面,是任何一个角色都没命名的颜色。
